name: JCC East Bay Mah Jongg
description: JCC East Bay (Rockridge, Oakland) offers a 4-part Intro to Mah Jongg class on American Mah Jongg (Sept 8-29 2026, $120 incl. 2026 card; sold out) and a weekly drop-in 'Monday Mah Jongg: All Levels Welcome'. Page describes the offerings as American Mah Jongg; no explicit NMJL sentence beyond the included 2026 Mah Jongg card.
schedule: Monday Mah Jongg every Monday 1-4pm from Sept 28 2026 (except holidays); advance registration encouraged

name: City of San Jose Mah Jong American Style Open Play (Camden Community Center)
description: San Jose Parks & Rec weekly open play for American-style Mah Jongg. Official page: attendees must bring their own '2026 National Mah Jongg League Standard Hands and Rules card'; sets provided; volunteer advisors. Ages 50+. Camden Community Center, Classroom 4.
address: Camden Community Center, 3369 Union Ave, San Jose, CA 95124
schedule: Wednesdays Sep 16-Dec 9 2026 (no class Nov 11 or Nov 25); Intermediate/Advanced Wednesdays Jan 6-Mar 10 2027; times not shown on page

name: Town of Danville Mah Jongg (Introduction to American Mahjong)
description: Town of Danville recreation class 'Introduction to American Mahjong' (instructor Jean Melgar) at the Veterans Memorial Building, ages 55+. Page: 'Bring your own 2026 National Mah Jongg League Card or optional $15 material fee due on the first day of class.'
address: Veterans Memorial Building, 115 E. Prospect Ave, Danville, CA 94526
schedule: Introduction class starting Mon Nov 9 2026 (time and total sessions not shown); price at registration

name: Bay Area Mahj
description: East Bay (Orinda, Lafayette, Moraga, Walnut Creek, Danville, Concord area) American Mahjong classes, parties and events run by Kerri. Site title: 'American Mahjong Classes, Parties & Events'; Tile Tuesdays free drop-in; ladder-style Bambird Scramble league requires a 2026 NMJL card. Site still shows some 2025 dates, so check currency.
schedule: Tile Tuesdays: Tuesdays 10am-12pm at Boichik Bagels, 2980 Treat Blvd, Concord (free); Holiday 2026 Scramble Nov 30 2026-Jan 3 2027 ($49)

name: Marinwood Community Center American Mah Jongg
description: Marinwood CSD (San Rafael) offers Beginner American Mah Jongg (Thursdays 12:30-3pm, instructor Carol Neel, $104; course covers 'how to interpret the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) card') and American Mah Jongg Open Play Wednesdays 1-3:30pm, $2 drop-in, Aug 26 2026-May 27 2027.
address: 775 Miller Creek Rd, San Rafael, CA 94903
schedule: Open play Wednesdays 1:00-3:30pm Aug 26 2026-May 27 2027 ($2 per person per week); Beginner Thursdays series 10/1-10/22 and 10/29-11/19 (no later sessions listed)
